acceptanceCriteria: Sealed cases for each tamper class with expected outcome, stage, code and verdictSha256, run in both consumer suites; the swap case's expected behaviour is stated in the spec.
body:
Panel finding (test-conformance). No native test on the stable path references PatchDigestMismatch, FabricatedEvidenceID, UncitedHunk, InvalidSpan or SpanOutOfRange; the native tamper suites (internal/cem/verify/corpus_test.go:239,:384) go through the 0.1 path that V1-1278 removes. Portable has some cases (packet03_test.go, cem_test.go:604). Swapping evidence IDs between hunks still ACCEPTs in both consumers (citation moves from anchored 2/specificity 2 to 0/-2, verdict unchanged). Repro: panel/test-conf/tamper/mk.py variants (span, ranges, swap, forged ID, drop, reorder).
